topics.title: Batch fan-out — the extension–app envelope
topics.index_line: why a whole-batch rejection keeps the app's own error text and hedges about the app's age instead of asserting it

topics.title: Claude input delivery
topics.index_line: how scheduled input reaches a claude session, and the routes that were tried and dropped; why a click-time note is plain text with no variables and never takes one of a button's stored input slots, what ✅ does and does not promise, which page a note goes to, what holds a split button's run, and why the popover lists the inputs before a note from the list that is sent

topics.title: cmux integration
topics.index_line: why the app asks the user to set one cmux option instead of setting it, why `rpc` is the only control path, how a launch retry is decided, and the measured placement contract for batch fan-out

topics.title: Reading GitHub pages
topics.index_line: why the repository buttons find GitHub's header as the banner landmark rather than by an attribute, why a PR's branch links are picked by document order rather than screen position, why those selectors reach the worker's injected functions as arguments, how a navigation the history wrappers cannot see is noticed, and why an insert pass that waited through one draws nothing

topics.title: Knowledge capture
topics.index_line: why this directory exists and how its tooling is installed

topics.title: Localization
topics.index_line: where the catalogues live, how macOS and Chrome independently choose each surface's language, the adjacent-generation compatibility boundary, and which strings may never become machine input

topics.title: Options page design
topics.index_line: why the options page shows GitHub placement, keeps example scenery fixed while editing live buttons, and separates page-specific rules from app-owned themes

topics.title: Options-page reordering
topics.index_line: why claude input rows stay in one card, why a redraw cancels a drag, and why the reorder tooltip key is shared by meaning

topics.title: Repository entry — how `{cd}` finds the repository
topics.index_line: why `{cd}` enters the zoxide folder named exactly `{repo}` instead of running `z {repo}`, why z.sh was dropped, and why the appended-prompt scanner judges `{cd}` as one word

topics.title: Setup window design
topics.index_line: why the setup window uses three toolbar panes, shared problems and pane previews

topics.title: Setup window sizing and placement
topics.index_line: why the window's measured size is applied outside the pass that measured it, and why one layout cycle gets one screen decision

topics.title: Signing and permissions
topics.index_line: the ad-hoc signing churn, and the permission it silently revoked

topics.title: Slack thread shortcut
topics.index_line: why the Slack thread workflow is Copy link plus a global shortcut the app registers, why the Shortcuts app and its URL scheme were dropped, and why the clipboard carries only a validated link

topics.title: Subprocess execution
topics.index_line: what actually bounds a timed-out child process, and why its output is decoded lossily

topics.title: Tab activation
topics.index_line: why a button's tab can open behind the screen you are on, why iTerm2 and WezTerm select your tab again, and why Warp always opens in front

topics.title: Testing decisions
topics.index_line: the typed source-audit boundary, the distinction between a source lint and a runtime oracle, why a gate goes on passing after the thing it describes moves, what a harness that drives its own layout stops measuring, what an out-of-tree harness of the content script can and cannot show, and why options-page help is checked against the variable contract rather than as strings

entries.revisit_when: the user chooses a different settings-window structure or preview treatment

entries.title: A request record, not a pipeline health claim
entries.source: user decision (2026-10-03); PR #108; `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowPresentation.swift` and `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowGeneralPane.swift`
entries.revisit_when: the recorded event changes from request arrival to evidence of command completion

entries.title: Problems appear first and use a status dot
entries.source: user decisions (2026-10-03); PR #108; `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowPresentation.swift`, `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowSharedPanel.swift`, and `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowController.swift`
entries.revisit_when: problem ordering, opening-reason lifetime, or the shared problem area's placement changes

entries.title: The repository base folder speaks only when unusable
entries.source: user decision (2026-10-03); PR #108; `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowPresentation.swift` and `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowGitHubPane.swift`
entries.revisit_when: the user asks for repository lookup guidance or the base-folder fallback changes

entries.title: Initial selection follows the opening cause
entries.source: user decision (2026-10-03); PR #108; `app/Sources/App/AppDelegate.swift` and `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowController.swift`
entries.revisit_when: the opening causes or pane-selection behavior changes

entries.title: App and extension icon identity
entries.source: user decisions (2026-10-03); PR #108; `app/AppIcon.icns`, `docs/assets/icon.png`, `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowGeneralPane.swift`, `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowPreviewView.swift`, and `extension/manifest.json`
entries.revisit_when: the source app icon is replaced or the user changes the icon treatment

entries.title: The measured size is applied outside the layout pass it was measured in
entries.source: issue #34; PR #54 (commits `37887c7`, `31fc333`); `FittedContentStackView` in `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowController.swift`
entries.revisit_when: AppKit gives the document view a way to re-dirty its enclosing scroll view from inside a layout pass, or the window stops being sized from its content

entries.title: One screen decision per layout cycle, and only the first measured size is centred
entries.source: issue #34; PR #54 (commits `56baa0d`, `7b39ea9`, `5645d14`); `centerInside`, `moveInside` and `buildContent` in `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowController.swift`
entries.revisit_when: the window stops being `isMovableByWindowBackground`, or the launch display becomes something the user can choose

entries.title: Reinstalling silently revoked the Accessibility permission
entries.source: app log, 2026-08-21 14:56 — `손쉬운 사용 권한이 없어 Warp 주입 헬퍼를 띄우지 않음`; resolved by `tccutil reset Accessibility com.dazebug.terminal-checkout` plus a re-grant, confirmed at 15:21 by a successful delivery
entries.revisit_when: the app gains a stable signing identity (issue #23, #33)

entries.title: The trigger is Copy link plus a keyboard shortcut
entries.source: User decision and driver measurements, 2026-10-02; [Slack Help — Manage apps in an Enterprise organization](https://slack.com/help/articles/360000281563-Manage-apps-in-an-Enterprise-organization); [Slack docs — Using Socket Mode](https://docs.slack.dev/apis/events-api/using-socket-mode)
entries.verification: corroborated by the linked Slack docs for app visibility and Socket Mode routing
entries.revisit_when: Slack documents a user-private message shortcut for its desktop app, or Socket Mode gains a per-user routing guarantee

entries.title: The app registers the shortcut itself
entries.source: User decision and driver measurements, 2026-10-03, Darwin 27.0.0
entries.verification: corroborated — measured end to end with the installed app — ⌃⇧⌘C pressed with Slack in front opened one session while the app's Accessibility permission was reset
entries.revisit_when: a shortcut assigned in the Shortcuts app fires whichever app is in front, or the app stops staying resident after it launches

entries.title: The clipboard can choose a thread, not a command
entries.source: User decisions, 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03; the request contract in `app/Sources/Core/SlackThreadRequest.swift`
entries.verification: corroborated by Core parser and request tests
entries.revisit_when: the request accepts another caller-controlled value or changes how the initial claude input is delivered

entries.title: The Shortcuts workflow was signed and configured locally
entries.source: User decision; [Apple — Run a shortcut while working on your Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-asia/guide/shortcuts-mac/apd163eb9f95/mac); driver measurements, 2026-10-02
entries.verification: corroborated by the removed Shortcuts installer and driver import/run measurements
entries.revisit_when: a Shortcuts-based trigger is reconsidered

entries.title: URL launch ordering was measured
entries.source: Driver AppKit probe, 2026-10-02, Darwin 27.0.0
entries.verification: corroborated by the recorded probe results
entries.revisit_when: the app registers a URL scheme again
entries.superseded_by: none — the app no longer registers a URL scheme; the platform behavior is unchanged

entries.title: The timeout's bound is closing the pipe readers, not killing a process group
entries.source: PR #60; measured on Darwin 25.4.0 — `setpgid` from the parent, 20 attempts out of 20
entries.revisit_when: a `runProcess` caller starts launching a long-lived GUI child directly, or Foundation exposes a child-side spawn attribute

entries.title: Output decodes lossily, and the invalid bytes are logged rather than repaired
entries.source: PR #60; `decoded(_:stream:)` in `app/Sources/Core/TerminalRunner.swift`
entries.revisit_when: a caller starts needing the exact original bytes of a child's output

entries.title: The exit is observed with `terminationHandler`, not `waitUntilExit()`
entries.source: the delivery-speed investigation that followed the maintainer's question about the marker
entries.revisit_when: a caller needs `NSTaskDidTerminateNotification`, which a handler suppresses

entries.title: The session gate's `ps` and `stty` get their own short limits, and a failure is logged
entries.source: field deliveries on cmux, the app's unified log, and a `sample` of the app during a stall
entries.revisit_when: a stall of the old length shows up again with these limits in place

entries.title: New tabs can open in the background
entries.source: maintainer request after a delivery test
entries.revisit_when: a terminal gains a way to create a tab that never takes focus, or Warp gains a way to read a tab that is not focused

entries.title: Source-audit claims are typed and derived
entries.source: PR #41 (closing change); `app/Sources/TestSupport/SourceAudit.swift`, `tests/source-audit.test.js`, and the source-reading tests under `app/Tests/`
entries.revisit_when: a test target needs a source-reading path that cannot go through `auditSource(_:claim:)`, or the Swift package gains a compiler-enforced test-support boundary

entries.title: The third instance of a defect class becomes a source audit instead of a third fix
entries.source: PR #60; `app/Sources/App/SetupWindowController.swift`, and the earlier `/usr/bin/osascript` occurrence count
entries.revisit_when: a source audit starts failing for a legitimate new call site often enough that the count is the thing being maintained

entries.title: When authority moves between two stores, the gates stay on the old one and everything passes
entries.source: PR #41 (ledger D296, D297, D300); `tests/i18n.test.js`, `extension/_locales/`, `extension/_i18n/`
entries.revisit_when: the compatibility passengers are retired (a second authority move, in the opposite direction), or a third catalogue surface appears

entries.title: Closure decisions preserved from PR #41

findings.message: 'Closure decisions preserved from PR #41': level-2 heading without any schema fields — fine for a prose section, an error if this was meant to be an entry

entries.title: A layout gate that drives its own layout is not measuring the window that ships
entries.source: issue #34; PR #54 (commits `37887c7`, `5645d14`); `app/Tests/AppTests/SetupWindowTestSupport.swift`
entries.revisit_when: these tests gain a way to observe an AppKit display cycle without pumping wall-clock time, or the window stops changing its own size from inside a layout pass

entries.title: Some defects cannot be a red here, and saying so beats building a seam
entries.source: issue #34; PR #54 (commit `56baa0d`); `docs/new-terminal-checklist.md`
entries.revisit_when: the suite gains a way to present more than one screen geometry to `NSScreen`, or the placement logic stops depending on the attached displays

entries.title: An out-of-tree DOM harness needs its own red toggles
entries.source: PR #57 (commit `a24e27a`); `CLAUDE.md`; measured with a disposable out-of-tree jsdom harness that loaded the real `options.html` with only `chrome` stubbed; for the content script, PR #90 and the lints in `tests/claude-note.test.js` those harnesses backed
entries.revisit_when: the suite gains a faithful DOM harness, or browser automation can complete a native `drop`

entries.title: A fixture's input values choose the branch, so a route can be green and never run
entries.source: issue #69; `app/Tests/CoreTests/CmuxGroupedExecutionTests.swift`; the cold review of the finished branch and the driver's live E2E on 2026-09-01
entries.revisit_when: the grouped placement routes gain an in-suite oracle that runs a real cmux server, or a new route is added without a live case

entries.title: Help text is checked against the variable contract, not against ten strings
entries.source: issue #78; PR #82 (commit `855a4c7`); `tests/i18n.test.js` (`every page kind help advertises its variables in every locale`)
entries.revisit_when: a kind's help legitimately needs to leave out a variable it accepts, or the help strings gain a structured variable list the options page renders itself
